claim: The deterministic post-failure recovery questions offer a comparison question the template binder rejects, so a failed run recommends its own next failure.
evidence: 3 of 9 failed runs 24h are period-over-period comparisons: beb26337 execution/invalid_analysis_plan ('...unusually high this month compared'), 53875a40 execution/invalid_analysis_plan, 78333587 execution/template_binding_rejected ('How did August 2026 category spending compare with July 2026?') — the same string hardcoded as a recovery question at agui.py:1380. Thread 9b46c3c8 shows the user re-asking after a failure (detector 3).

claim: The AG-UI terminal event reports success for runs the durable log records as failed, so replay consumers and the UI cannot reconstruct the run's real verdict.
evidence: 7 of 9 failed/degraded runs 24h (beb26337, 81a33d1f, 53875a40, 540d33e7, 78333587, 75c36418, 5f14819d) ended with /fyn/phase='succeeded' and RunFinishedSuccessOutcome; only the 2 transport RuntimeErrors (143f3b18, 12a754ae) emitted RUN_ERROR. agui.py:1706 hardcodes the phase literal; agui.py:1715 always builds RunFinishedSuccessOutcome; the true verdict rides only in /fyn/taskStatus (agui.py:1708), which no frontend component reads.

claim: Degraded runs deliver an answer the grounding verifier could not verify, and the UI shows it identically to a verified answer.
evidence: 4 of 12 failed/degraded runs in 24h are task_status='degraded', error_code='unverified_model_reply' (43ab5c2e, 8a8f7d29, 81a33d1f, 75c36418) - the single largest class. All four emitted RUN_FINISHED, not RUN_ERROR. taskStatus exists in frontend/src/lib/generated/contracts.ts:511 but grep over frontend/src finds no component reading it; the only non-generated hit is a test comment at widget-renderer.test.tsx:491.
pattern: deterministic-guardrails - openai/openai-agents-python (tripwire results surfaced as typed outcomes)

claim: A bare Python NameError reached the user-facing transport stage, so the failure-only branches of the streaming path have no import-time or test-time invariant proving their symbols resolve.
evidence: Run f63872be RUN_ERROR payload: code='NameError', detail="name '_answer_contract_failure' is not defined", after 3 transport-stage failures in 24h (3x RuntimeError + this NameError). The symbol resolves nowhere in backend/app today nor in the running container, so the failure branch that called it was never executed before it shipped.
pattern: declarative-registries - langgenius/dify, n8n-io/n8n (behavior declared as data with import-time invariants)

evidence: user_preferences 'agent:answer_validation' = {"mode":"off"} since 2026-08-19 00:07:13. Grounding-stage failures land AFTER it: 355fa24d ungrounded_financial_claim 00:07:23, d5ef78a6 ungrounded_financial_claim 00:07:54, 6bc974af unsupported_count_claim 00:42:21. Grounding is 10 of 21 failed/degraded runs in 24h. Shipped copy in settings-agent.tsx reads 'Publish read answers without grounding, evidence, or completeness checks.'
pattern: deterministic-guardrails - openai/openai-agents-python (tripwires separated from model judgment, surfaced as typed outcomes)

claim: A grounding error class reached production with no test naming it, so the code the UI and the run log both key on is unpinned.
evidence: answer_validation.py:75 returns 'unsupported_count_claim'; grep over backend/tests finds zero references to it. It first appears in the run log today as 6bc974af (degraded, 00:42:21). Sibling codes on the same branch ('unsupported_money_claim', 'unsupported_percentage_claim', 'unsupported_financial_claim') are equally unreferenced. This is diff predicate P2 firing after the fact.
pattern: trace-evals-as-config - promptfoo/promptfoo, confident-ai/deepeval (assertions declared as config, evaluated reproducibly)

claim: UndoToastList dispatches on an untyped string equality check with the destructive delete-undo markup as the unlabeled default branch, so any toast whose type isn't exactly 'settings-saved'/'settings-problem' silently renders as a live undo-delete slip with no compiler or test catching the mismatch.
evidence: frontend/src/components/workspace.tsx:463 'slip.type === SETTINGS_TOAST_SAVED || slip.type === SETTINGS_TOAST_PROBLEM ? <status slip> : <undo-delete slip>' - the else branch is the same markup that deleteThread's toast.add at workspace.tsx:1889 uses for a real destructive undo (actionProps.onClick sets pending.current...undone=true, timeout=UNDO_WINDOW_MS). settings-parts.tsx:18-19 defines the two matched strings as bare consts, not a shared union, and node_modules/@base-ui/react/toast/useToastManager.d.ts:24 types toast.type as 'string | undefined' with no library-level exhaustiveness. Diff predicates P1-P4 (.claude/skills/signal/predicates.py, SCOPE='backend/app/') do not fire on this diff since every changed file is under frontend/ - none apply here, this finding is independent of them.
pattern: declarative-registries - langgenius/dify, n8n-io/n8n (behavior declared as data with import-time invariants, not an if/else a caller must remember to extend)

claim: The deterministic question-ideas router only recognizes a narrow set of phrasings, so a user who explicitly and repeatedly asked for example questions never got the tappable RELATED_QUESTIONS chips the feature exists to deliver — both turns fell through to a generic prose reply instead.
evidence: Conversation 47129e5f-1a33-4c66-91d5-299ece739ef9: user 00:47:01 'So here's some absolutely complex question which your application cannot answer.' -> generic capability blurb, no questions. User 00:47:23 'But my instruction was to share some complex question. You did not share anything. Every time when I say that, you should come up with some examples.' -> a prose numbered list, still not chips. Both turns logged as ai_actions action_type='operator' (00:47:03, 00:47:26), never 'related_questions'. conversation.py:2661-2665 _QUESTION_IDEAS_REQUEST only matches 'suggest/recommend...question', 'question...to ask/I can/could/should ask', or 'what should/can/could I ask' — neither user phrasing matches any branch, so the deterministic route at conversation.py:4992 (which calls suggest_related_questions in agents.py:1374 and renders a tappable RELATED_QUESTIONS widget) never fires.
pattern: none in products.md yet — claim stands on run-log evidence alone (conversation 47129e5f, ai_actions rows, regex at conversation.py:2661)

evidence: agent_runs: 084e66ff-2a68-4852-840a-3ca74847f6cb task_status='failed' failure_stage='grounding' error_code='required_operation_handoff_missing'; e40547c6-da04-467f-9b5d-b28896f67a67 task_status='failed' failure_stage='clarification_resolution' error_code='clarification_did_not_progress'. Neither run nor stage was in the prior ledger's 7-run sample. Both agent_events STATE_DELTA rows for these runs carry, in the SAME delta array: {"op":"replace","path":"/fyn/phase","value":"succeeded"} beside {"op":"add","path":"/fyn/taskStatus","value":"failed"}; both RUN_FINISHED events used RunFinishedSuccessOutcome() (agui.py:1723), not RUN_ERROR. Source: agui.py:1707-1726 has no branch on response.task_status anywhere in the non-interrupt return path -- the phase literal at agui.py:1710 is unconditional. required_operation_handoff_missing (conversation.py:5786) has zero references under backend/tests/ (P2, predicates.py) -- clarification_did_not_progress is tested (test_agui_runtime.py:550) but the transport-invisibility bug it triggers is not.
escalation: prior ledger entry (2026-08-19, same claim id) evidenced 7 runs across execution/intent_resolution/transport stages via cross-table comparison; this pass adds 2 new runs from a stage never before observed (clarification_resolution) and a same-payload self-contradiction (phase vs taskStatus in one STATE_DELTA), proving the defect is universal to every failure_stage rather than scoped to the ones originally sampled.

claim: Date-format clarification answers are threaded back through the fast intent gate as unstructured prose instead of a typed continuation, so the identical resolved text is reclassified nondeterministically and can re-trigger the same ambiguity, dead-ending the user with no recovery but retyping the whole question from scratch.
evidence: Run e40547c6 (conversation 9b46c3c8, 02:50:03): resumed text 'Hi, Show my expenses from 03/04/2026 to 05/06/2026\n\nCustomer clarification (authoritative): Day / month / year. Use start_date=2026-04-03 and end_date=2026-06-05... Do not ask the same question again.' was reclassified by deterministic_date_policy as 'Detected two valid date-range interpretations' with the same fingerprint as the original ask, so _clarification_stall_reason (conversation.py:962) fired 'The resumed route reproduced the same clarification.' and the run failed closed: task_status=failed, failure_stage=clarification_resolution, error_code=clarification_did_not_progress, message 'I couldn't turn that confirmed choice into a complete executable plan, so I stopped instead of asking the same question again. No changes were made.' The only way forward was retyping the identical original prompt (messages table, 02:53:18): run 670101ab asked the same clarification again, but the very next run 5866d982 (02:53:20) with the byte-identical resumed+annotation text routed straight to transaction_list and succeeded -- proving the classification of the same resumed string is nondeterministic, not content-dependent.
pattern: none in products.md yet -- claim stands on run-log evidence alone (runs e40547c6, 670101ab, 5866d982; continuations.py:17-42 GovernedQueryContinuation/GovernedTaxonomyContinuation carry typed slots and skip reclassification, LegacyPromptContinuation at continuations.py:34 is documented as 'Compatibility path for workflows that do not yet expose typed slots' and conversation.py:4650-4670 threads date-clarification answers through it as prose)

claim: The fyn deploy pipeline's only proof a deploy shipped the intended code is a bodiless health-check reachability check racing an unrelated SSH git-log lookup, so a container that never actually rebuilt (cache hit, no-op compose up) would still print 'DEPLOY COMPLETE' labeled with the new commit while serving old code.
evidence: infra/deploy/deploy.sh:119-127 sets public_ok=true purely on curl reachability of FYN_HEALTH_URL and never compares the response body to server_sha; the commit line at deploy.sh:140 ('echo "  commit    ${server_sha:0:7}"') is sourced from `git rev-parse HEAD` run over SSH on the server filesystem (deploy.sh:76), never from the responding process. backend/app/api.py:212-224 health()/HealthOut (backend/app/schemas.py:1176-1183) returns status/time/database/agent_mode/models/operationCatalog with no version or commit field; grep over backend/Dockerfile and infra/deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml finds zero GIT_SHA/version build-args. infra/deploy/status.sh:9-19 independently works around the same gap by SSHing to run git log rather than reading it off the health response. User's own turn note: 'Known gap I documented rather than fixed: /api/health reports no version or commit, so the health response cannot prove which code is live; status.sh uses the server's git SHA instead.'
pattern: event-sourced-runs - temporalio/temporal; langchain-ai/langgraph (durable, self-describing state as the basis for audit/observation, applied here to the deploy layer instead of the agent-run layer)

claim: The exact same byte-identical analysis question, re-asked in one conversation, gets a different verdict almost every time (succeeded, degraded, or one of three distinct failure codes) because no prior verified answer in the conversation is ever reused, so a retry is a gamble with no visible odds.
evidence: Conversation 47129e5f-1a33-4c66-91d5-299ece739ef9, normalized string 'compare my food and transport spending from may through august 19, group it by month, identify the largest merchants, and compare it with the previous three-month average.' sent 12 times (22:49:00-00:15:48): runs 2d824e27 succeeded, 8a8f7d29 degraded/unverified_model_reply, 43ab5c2e degraded/unverified_model_reply, 01148838 succeeded, 72dedf84 succeeded, b7e9e1cf succeeded, 703085d9 failed/unknown_column, 8c250602 failed/execution_error, 42f5d124 succeeded, 5700a27b succeeded, c406e43a failed/unknown_table, 6e9a2b5c succeeded -- 7 succeeded/2 degraded/3 failed (3 distinct error_codes) for one fixed string. Second string 'compare flight spending in august 2026 versus july 2026.' sent 6 times in 16 min: 53aab03c, c978733e, 355fa24d, d5ef78a6 all failed/grounding/ungrounded_financial_claim, then 25fb8906 and 7821ee83 succeeded. No dedup/cache exists: grep for temperature/seed/cache/dedup across template_retrieval.py, template_binding.py, sql_analysis.py, answer_validation.py, conversation.py returns nothing relevant. These 15 run ids are new -- none appear in the prior 2026-08-19 ledger entry that cited only 3 comparison-question runs (beb26337, 53875a40, 78333587).
pattern: text-to-SQL with retrieval over verified queries - vanna-ai/vanna (RAG over a store of validated question/SQL pairs, so a repeated question is answered from the verified store, not regenerated)
